title: 生物风险管理：入门单元

points.K1: 生物风险管理的两部分
points.K2: 生物安全：防止无意释放
points.K3: 生物安保：防止有意滥用
points.K17: 个人防护：最后一道防线

shots.scene: 欣欣站在生物安全实验室门口，门上贴着生物危害标志，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the door of a biosafety laboratory with a biohazard warning sign and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天上生物风险管理的第一课。
overlay: 生物风险管理：入门单元

shots.scene: 欣欣举起三块空白卡片，分别画着放大镜、盾牌、对勾图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up three blank cards with a magnifier icon, a shield icon and a check mark icon.
shots.narration: 先把几个关键词弄明白。

shots.scene: 阿杰第一次走进微生物实验室，好奇地四处张望
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks into a microbiology laboratory for the first time and looks around curiously.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次进微生物实验室。

shots.scene: 阿杰指着冰箱上的生物危害标志，挠头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at a biohazard warning sign on a laboratory refrigerator and scratches his head.
shots.narration: 他问：生物安全和生物安保，有啥不同？

shots.scene: 小研拿着空白笔记本走过来微笑
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over holding a blank notebook and smiles at him.
shots.narration: 小研说：一个防意外，一个防坏人。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 我们从头讲起。

shots.section_title: 生物风险管理的两部分
shots.scene: 一把大伞下分出两把小伞，分别画着盾牌和锁的图标
shots.prompt_en: A large umbrella icon covering two smaller umbrellas, one with a shield icon and one with a padlock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 生物风险管理，包括两部分：
overlay: 生物风险管理的两部分

shots.section_title: 生物风险管理的两部分
shots.scene: 盾牌图标和锁图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon and a padlock icon side by side with a biohazard warning sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全管理和生物安保管理。

shots.section_title: 生物安全：防止无意释放
shots.scene: 实验室墙上出现裂缝，小点从裂缝飘出
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a laboratory room with a small crack in the wall and tiny dots drifting out. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全，防的是无意的释放。
overlay: 生物安全：防止无意释放

shots.section_title: 生物安全：防止无意释放
shots.scene: 门密封条老化，空气箭头从门缝漏出
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a laboratory door with a worn seal and airflow arrows leaking through the gap. No people.
shots.narration: 比如设施出故障，防护失效。

shots.section_title: 生物安全：防止无意释放
shots.scene: 小点飘向城市里的人群图标
shots.prompt_en: Tiny dots drifting from a laboratory building toward an icon of a town with many small people outlines. No people.
shots.narration: 虽不是故意的，也会危害公众。

shots.section_title: 生物安保：防止有意滥用
shots.scene: 黑影手伸向冰箱，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A dark shadow hand reaching toward a locked laboratory refrigerator, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安保，防的是有意的滥用。
overlay: 生物安保：防止有意滥用

shots.section_title: 生物安保：防止有意滥用
shots.scene: 上锁的样品柜和监控摄像头
shots.prompt_en: A locked sample cabinet with a padlock and a security camera above it. No people.
shots.narration: 防止有人盗取病原，故意伤人。

shots.section_title: 生物安保：防止有意滥用
shots.scene: 天平两端：意外图标与恶意图标
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale icon: an accident icon on one side and a masked figure icon on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 两者的区别，就在于意图。

shots.scene: 一个透明罩子罩住微生物图标
shots.prompt_en: A transparent dome covering a cluster of microbe icons, with the edge of the dome highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 防护，就是给生物因子划定边界。

shots.scene: 微生物图标被挡在罩子里，外面的街道干净
shots.prompt_en: Microbe icons stay inside the dome while the street and houses outside stay clean. No people.
shots.narration: 让它留在设施里，不逸出伤人。

shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜前操作，柜子周围画着内圈
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works at a biological safety cabinet, with an inner highlighted circle drawn around her and the cabinet.
shots.narration: 一级防护，保护操作的人。

shots.scene: 生物安全柜和防护服的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a biological safety cabinet, a lab gown, gloves and goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 靠安全柜和个人防护装备。

shots.scene: 整栋实验楼外画着外圈
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory building with an outer highlighted ring around it, showing a sealed room, an exhaust filter and a waste autoclave icon. No people.
shots.narration: 二级防护，保护外面的环境。

shots.scene: 两个同心圈同时亮起
shots.prompt_en: Two concentric rings, inner and outer, light up together around a laboratory. No people.
shots.narration: 两层防护，要同时做到。

shots.scene: 细菌、病毒、真菌孢子的卡通图标排成一排
shots.prompt_en: Cartoon icons of a bacterium, a virus particle and a fungal spore in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 细菌、病毒、真菌，都可能是生物因子。

shots.scene: 朊病毒折叠蛋白的抽象图标
shots.prompt_en: An abstract icon of a misfolded protein next to tiny particle icons. No people.
shots.narration: 还有朊病毒这样的致病颗粒。

shots.scene: 这些图标外面加上警示三角
shots.prompt_en: The microbe and particle icons framed by a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 凡能对人造成危害，都要管。

shots.scene: 四级台阶，每级空白
shots.prompt_en: Four steps rising from low to high, each step blank, with a small warning icon on each. No people.
shots.narration: 生物因子还要分危险度等级。

shots.scene: 地球图标旁边出现四级台阶
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon next to the four blank steps. No people.
shots.narration: 世界卫生组织定义了四个等级。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着台阶，旁边画着下一课的箭头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the four steps, with an arrow pointing to a blank next-lesson card.
shots.narration: 各级具体是什么，后面再细讲。

shots.scene: 三个圆圈箭头：放大镜、盾牌、对勾
shots.prompt_en: Three linked circles with arrows: a magnifier icon, a shield icon and a check mark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 生物风险管理分三步走。

shots.scene: 放大镜图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: The magnifier icon lights up while the other two dim. No people.
shots.narration: 第一步，先评估风险。

shots.scene: 盾牌图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: The shield icon lights up while the other two dim. No people.
shots.narration: 第二步，采取控制，降低风险。

shots.scene: 对勾图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: The check mark icon lights up while the other two dim. No people.
shots.narration: 第三步，检查控制是否有效。

shots.scene: 三个图标连成圆环，不停转动
shots.prompt_en: The three icons joined in a ring of arrows that keeps turning. No people.
shots.narration: 三步连成一个圈，循环往复。

shots.scene: 圆环每转一圈，向上升一级
shots.prompt_en: The turning ring rises a little higher with each turn, like a spiral going up. No people.
shots.narration: 每转一圈，管理就更好一点。

shots.scene: 一张空白网格，横轴后果、纵轴可能性
shots.prompt_en: A blank grid chart with colored cells from green to red, axes marked only with arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 评估风险，常用风险矩阵。

shots.scene: 骰子图标代表可能性
shots.prompt_en: A dice icon next to a cracked container icon. No people.
shots.narration: 可能性：防护失效有多容易发生。

shots.scene: 人和树的图标受到冲击
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person and a tree hit by a small wave of dots. No people.
shots.narration: 后果：对人和环境的伤害有多大。

shots.scene: 两个数在网格上交汇到红格
shots.prompt_en: A marker moves across the grid and stops in a red cell where the two arrows meet. No people.
shots.narration: 两者一结合，就看出风险高低。

shots.scene: 冰箱里放着密封的样品管
shots.prompt_en: A closed laboratory refrigerator with sealed sample tubes on a shelf, small green indicator. No people.
shots.narration: 样品放在冰箱里，没有风险。

shots.scene: 小研取出样品管放进生物安全柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes a sealed tube out of the refrigerator and carries it to a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 一拿出来开盖处理，风险就上升。

shots.scene: 四个空白图标：提取、扩增、检测
shots.prompt_en: Four blank process icons in a row: a tube, a centrifuge, a thermal cycler and a microplate. No people.
shots.narration: 提取、扩增、检测，步骤越多，

shots.scene: 风险仪表指针一格格升高
shots.prompt_en: A risk gauge needle moving up step by step from green toward orange. No people.
shots.narration: 风险就越来越高。

shots.scene: 五块积木叠成一面墙
shots.prompt_en: Five building blocks stacked into a protective wall, each with a different icon. No people.
shots.narration: 降低风险，靠五类控制措施。

shots.scene: 五块积木互相咬合
shots.prompt_en: The five blocks interlock tightly; one block pulled out leaves a gap in the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 它们要配合使用，缺一块就有漏洞。

shots.scene: 高危样品图标被打叉，旁边门牌不合格
shots.prompt_en: A high-hazard sample icon crossed out with a red X next to a laboratory door icon with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 消除：风险太高或设施不够，

shots.scene: 老周摇头，把空白申请单放回
shots.prompt_en: The older man shakes his head and puts a blank experiment request form back into the tray.
shots.narration: 这个实验就不做。

shots.scene: 强壮的病原图标变成虚弱的小图标
shots.prompt_en: A strong spiky microbe icon turns into a small, weak, pale microbe icon. No people.
shots.narration: 替代：换成减毒、弱化的株，

shots.scene: 风险仪表指针下降到绿色
shots.prompt_en: A risk gauge needle drops from orange to green. No people.
shots.narration: 在实验室里更好管理，风险更低。

shots.scene: 生物安全柜、负压实验室剖面图
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a containment laboratory with a biological safety cabinet, an airlock and inward airflow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 工程控制：专门设计的防护设施，

shots.scene: 老李检查实验室送排风设备
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the ventilation units of a containment laboratory with a blank clipboard.
shots.narration: 把病原关住，给人安全的环境。

shots.scene: 王老师给学生们发空白操作规程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands out blank standard operating procedure booklets to the young male student and the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 管理控制：标准操作规程，

shots.scene: 阿杰在培训教室听讲
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits in a training room watching a slide with only icons on the screen.
shots.narration: 还有培训，让人人照规矩做。

shots.section_title: 个人防护：最后一道防线
shots.scene: 小研穿好隔离衣，戴手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a solid-front lab gown and nitrile gloves.
shots.narration: 个人防护，是最后一道防线。
overlay: 个人防护：最后一道防线

shots.section_title: 个人防护：最后一道防线
shots.scene: 防护服挡住飞来的小点
shots.prompt_en: Tiny dots bounce off a protective gown and gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 防护服挡住皮肤接触。

shots.section_title: 个人防护：最后一道防线
shots.scene: 气溶胶小点飘向口鼻，防护口罩挡住
shots.prompt_en: Aerosol dots float toward a face outline and are stopped by a fitted respirator mask. No people.
shots.narration: 经气溶胶传播的，要做呼吸防护。

shots.section_title: 个人防护：最后一道防线
shots.scene: 口罩和电动送风呼吸器头罩的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a face mask and a powered air-purifying respirator hood side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 可用口罩，或电动送风呼吸器。

shots.section_title: 个人防护：最后一道防线
shots.scene: 护目镜挡住溅向眼睛的液滴
shots.prompt_en: Goggles block a splash of droplets flying toward the eyes. No people.
shots.narration: 能经眼睛感染的，要戴护目镜。

shots.scene: 五块积木墙后面还剩一个小风险点
shots.prompt_en: Behind the five-block wall, one small orange risk dot remains. No people.
shots.narration: 做完所有控制，还会剩下一点风险。

shots.scene: 小研和老周一起看空白评估表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the older man review a blank risk assessment form together at a desk.
shots.narration: 能否接受，由实验人员和管理层判断。

shots.scene: 不同实验室的剩余风险点大小不同
shots.prompt_en: Three laboratory room icons, each with a different sized orange dot. No people.
shots.narration: 各设施不同，要结合本单位实际。

shots.scene: 小研翻看空白记录本
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student flips through a blank logbook and checks the pages.
shots.narration: 绩效评估，就是回头查记录。

shots.scene: 记录中找到一个红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A blank logbook page with a red exclamation mark icon highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 看看有没有发生防护失效。

shots.scene: 空白规程被修改，加上新的一页
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure document with a new page added and a pencil icon. No people.
shots.narration: 出了事故或事件，就修订规程。

shots.scene: 一排整齐的空白文件夹，带编号图标
shots.prompt_en: A row of neat blank binders on a shelf, each with a number icon and a lock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 每项生物安全工作，都要有记录。

shots.scene: 文件之间连线，能一路追溯
shots.prompt_en: Linked document icons connected by a line from start to end, with a magnifier following the line. No people.
shots.narration: 记录受控、可追溯，问题才查得出。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现盾牌和锁两个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating shield and padlock icons.
shots.narration: 生物安全防意外，生物安保防滥用。

shots.scene: 两层防护圈和四级台阶
shots.prompt_en: Icons of two concentric protection rings and a set of four steps. No people.
shots.narration: 两层防护同时做，因子分四个等级。

shots.scene: 三步循环与五块积木
shots.prompt_en: Icons of the three-step ring and the five-block wall. No people.
shots.narration: 评估、减缓、绩效，五类控制配合。

shots.scene: 记录本和放大镜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a logbook and a magnifier. No people.
shots.narration: 记录受控可追溯，发现问题就改。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验室门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the door of the biosafety laboratory.
shots.narration: 管好风险，安心做实验，下次见！
